sshForm.name: Name
sshForm.passwordPlaceholderEdit: Leave blank to keep the current password
sshForm.passphrasePlaceholderEdit: Leave blank to keep the current passphrase
sshForm.noteKey: VibeSSH reads the key from this path on disk when it connects - it never copies the file's contents.
sshForm.notePassword: The password is stored in your OS credential store, never in a plain file.
sshForm.noteEdit: Leaving the password/passphrase blank keeps the one already saved - test connection needs it re-entered to check a changed credential.
sshForm.noteAdd: Test connection opens a real SSH connection and closes it again - it doesn't save anything.

applications.title: Applications
applications.subtitle: Processes, systemd units, and containers VibeSSH manages for you.
applications.emptyDescription: Create one from an Egg - run a command locally, or manage a process, systemd unit, or container on a remote server.

applicationDetail.notRunning: Not running - resource usage shows once it's started.

confirmBody.stop: Stop <1>{{name}}</1>? It will shut down gracefully.
confirmBody.kill: Force-kill <1>{{name}}</1>? This ends it immediately, without a graceful shutdown - any unsaved state it was holding is lost.
confirmBody.recreate: Recreate the container for <1>{{name}}</1>? Any change to its image, command, resource limits, or restart policy since it was last created takes effect. Its files (working directory) are untouched - only the container itself is removed and created again.

applicationDetail.migrateBody: Move "{{name}}" to a different Node: VibeSSH stops it, provisions an identical copy on the target, copies its files over, repoints its DNS alias if it has one, then removes the original from VibeSSH. This takes it offline for the duration of the copy. Like any application delete, the stopped container and its files are left behind on the original Node, not wiped - remove them by hand once you've confirmed the move worked.
applicationDetail.migrateSuccessToast: Migrated to the new Node as {{name}}.

portsTab.description: Declared ports for this application - documentation of intent, not a live guarantee (VibeSSH doesn't check whether the port is actually free on the host yet).
portsTab.emptyDescription: Add one to document which ports this application uses.
portsTab.name: Name
portsTab.invalidForm: Enter a name and a valid port number (1-65535).
portsTab.firewallSyncNote: Publishing a port opens it on the Node's firewall automatically - use this to retry, or to sync a port declared before this existed.
portsTab.firewallSyncLocal: This application runs locally - there's no Node firewall to sync.
portsTab.firewallSyncNoBackend: No supported firewall was detected on this Node.

healthCheck.title: Health check
healthCheck.noPorts: This application has no TCP ports declared yet - add one on the Ports tab first.
healthCheck.formPortRequired: Choose a port for this health check type.

resourceLimits.title: Resource limits
resourceLimits.dockerNote: A change here only takes effect the next time this container is recreated (removed and started again) - same as an edited image or command.
resourceLimits.invalidForm: Enter a positive number, or leave a field blank for no limit.

deleteApplicationDialog.title: Delete application
deleteApplicationDialog.body: Delete <1>{{name}}</1>? This removes it from VibeSSH - it won't stop a still-running process/unit/container on its own; stop it first if it's running. This can't be undone.

databaseHosts.title: Database Hosts
databaseHosts.subtitle: MySQL/MariaDB engines VibeSSH can provision application databases on.
databaseHosts.emptyDescription: Add one to let applications provision their own databases on it.
databaseHosts.deleteBody: Remove "{{name}}"? This only removes it from VibeSSH - it doesn't touch the database engine itself. Rejected while any database is still provisioned on it.
databaseHosts.name: Name
databaseHosts.linkedServerNote: VibeSSH provisions databases by running the mysql/mariadb client over SSH on the linked Server - without one, this host can be registered but nothing can be created on it yet.
databaseHosts.adminPasswordNote: Needs CREATE DATABASE/CREATE USER/GRANT privileges. Stored in your OS credential store, never in plain text.
databaseHosts.invalidForm: Fill in a name, host, admin username, and admin password.
databaseHosts.phpmyadminHelp: Link the Docker application running phpMyAdmin for this host (e.g. a "Generic Docker Container" application using the phpmyadmin/phpmyadmin image). This only records the link - opening phpMyAdmin from here isn't available yet.
databaseHosts.noDockerApplications: No Docker applications yet - create one running the phpmyadmin/phpmyadmin image first.

databasesTab.emptyDescription: Create one below - the name, username, and password are all generated for you.
databasesTab.noHosts: No database hosts are registered yet - add one on the <1>Database Hosts</1> page first.
databasesTab.generatedNote: The database name, username, and password are generated automatically - "purpose" only seeds the generated name so it's recognizable.
databasesTab.deleteBody: Remove "{{name}}"? This drops the actual database and its user on the database server - all data in it is permanently deleted. This can't be undone.

applicationFilesTab.emptyDescription: Upload a file or create a new one to get started.
applicationFilesTab.deleteBody: Remove "{{name}}"? This permanently deletes it (and everything inside it, if it's a folder). This can't be undone.
applicationFilesTab.moveNote: Relative to the application's own root - e.g. "plugins/MyPlugin.jar".
applicationFilesTab.jarReplaceBody: "{{name}}" is the jar file the current startup configuration launches. Uploading it now will overwrite it - the running application won't pick up the new file until it's restarted.

applicationFileEditor.tooLarge: File is too large to edit directly.
applicationFileEditor.discardBody: "{{name}}" has unsaved changes. Closing now discards them.

fileHistory.title: Version history - {{name}}
fileHistory.emptyDescription: A version is saved automatically whenever "Backup before save" is on and you save a change.
